description: The pie chart, titled "Task Type," illustrates the distribution of two task types in the context of generative AI's use in journalism, as presented in the paper "Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism." The chart is divided into two segments: a large red segment representing "Article generation," which accounts for 83.2% of the total, and a smaller yellow segment representing "Headline generation," which makes up 16.8%. The percentages are explicitly labeled next to their corresponding colored slices, and the chart uses a donut-style design with a white center containing the title. The visual emphasis is on the significant dominance of article generation over headline generation in this dataset.
